root_cause.diagnosis: State-dependent template staleness, not a missing control. The template was cropped from an ENABLED 出征 button whose stamina cost reads '10' in WHITE. With stamina 5 the client renders the same button at the same position with the cost '10' in RED, and the pHash distance jumps from ~0 to 26. Crops of template vs live frame are geometrically identical; the only difference is the cost digit colour.
root_cause.secondary_observation: The outcome is arguably correct (cost 10 > stamina 5, so the dispatch could not have succeeded anyway), but the agent reports it as 'the control is not on screen', which is a wrong reason and will keep poisoning DISPATCH_INTEL_BEAST success-rate statistics and Recovery decisions.
fix_direction: SUPERSEDED by evidence/corpus_btn_beast_dispatch_20260915.json: the template route is CLOSED. A 2795-frame corpus measurement shows the disabled-state distance (26) sits inside a dense band of unrelated frames (28 at d=24, 41 at d=26, 114 at d=28), visually confirmed to be mail banners, mail buttons, alliance claim buttons, rally-join buttons and blank regions. No threshold separates them.

The correct fix is an explicit state branch: on the already-correctly-classified beast formation page, read the stamina cost on the 出征 button and compare it with current stamina; if cost > stamina, report insufficient stamina and BACK out, instead of SEMANTIC_TARGET_NOT_VERIFIED.
Do NOT relax the threshold to ~26 and do NOT add a second disabled-state template.
root_cause.promotion_gate: RESOLVED AS 'APPROACH DISPROVEN' - no longer a PROMOTION BLOCKED item. The template/threshold candidate was eliminated by corpus evidence rather than left waiting for samples. See evidence/corpus_btn_beast_dispatch_20260915.json.
